trained_on: 6 MIBiG polyether + AS-XXX (5 compounds) + selvamicin/HH130629; lipopeptide gates from daptomycin/surfactin/orfamide architecture

scanners.name: Aminocyclitol / acarviostatin
scanners.trap: GlgB/GlgE glycogen amylases (TIGR02100/02401) are NOT the acarbose amylase
scanners.why: alpha-glucosidase inhibitors; anti-Candida
scanners.test_note: 0 hits — correctly confirms no acarviostatin in AS-XXX

scanners.name: Polyene macrolide
scanners.trap: any large T1PKS; require the polyene chromophore module count + mycosamine sugar
scanners.why: membrane-ergosterol binding; classic antifungals
scanners.test_note: fired 19 — gating on generic KS; needs polyene-specific module count + mycosamine sugar

scanners.name: HSAF / polycyclic tetramate macrolactam (PTM)
scanners.trap: generic NRPS-PKS; require the OAT + iterative signature
scanners.why: already recurrent across your bee strains; antifungal
scanners.test_note: fired 34 — gating on generic NRPS/PKS/aminotran; needs iterative PKS-NRPS + OAT co-occurrence, not OR

scanners.name: Echinocandin-like lipopeptide
scanners.rule: cyclic NRPS + acyl chain + multiple hydroxylations
scanners.why: beta-1,3-glucan synthase inhibitors; anti-Candida
scanners.test_note: no domain-name proxy available; needs HMM to test

scanners.name: Antifungal polyketide-polyene (heptaene)
scanners.why: distinct from carotenoids; targets fungal membrane
scanners.test_note: no domain-name proxy available; needs HMM to test

scanners.name: Glycopeptide (vancomycin-family)
scanners.trap: any P450-carrying NRPS; require the Oxy crosslinking cascade
scanners.why: D-Ala-D-Ala binding; anti-MRSA gold standard
scanners.test_note: no domain-name proxy available; needs HMM to test

scanners.name: Lanthipeptide subclass discriminator
scanners.rule: classify by modification enzyme present (mutually exclusive gates)
scanners.why: you have I and III; BGC050 divergent LanB matters
scanners.test_note: fired only BGC049+BGC050 — the two known lanthipeptides; discriminates I vs III

scanners.name: Thiopeptide
scanners.why: 50S ribosome / EF-Tu inhibitors; Gram-positive
scanners.test_note: 0 hits — no thiopeptide gate present (YcaO absent)

scanners.name: Beta-lactam (nocardicin/clavam/cephamycin)
scanners.why: cell-wall synthesis inhibitors
scanners.test_note: no domain-name proxy available; needs HMM to test

scanners.name: Aminoglycoside
scanners.trap: confusing with acarbose aminocyclitol (AF01) — different synthase
scanners.why: 30S ribosome inhibitors; broad Gram-negative
scanners.test_note: 0 hits — no DOIS aminoglycoside synthase

scanners.name: Pleuromutilin / diterpene antibiotic
scanners.why: 50S ribosome; the tiamulin/lefamulin scaffold
scanners.test_note: no domain-name proxy available; needs HMM to test

scanners.name: Enediyne warhead
scanners.rule: enediyne core PKSE (NOT just the aminosugar)
scanners.trap: neocarzinostatin SUGAR hit alone (BGC014) does not prove the warhead
scanners.why: DNA-cleaving; extremely potent
scanners.test_note: 0 hits — enediyne PKSE absent (BGC014 has the SUGAR only, correctly not flagged as warhead)

scanners.name: Nonheme-iron halogenase capacity
scanners.trap: haloacid dehalogenase (HAD) is NOT a halogenase
scanners.why: halogenation frequently correlates with bioactivity
scanners.test_note: 0 hits in AS-XXX — halogenase absent (present in Amel2 BGC051 per earlier finding)

scanners.name: Activated dTDP-deoxysugar hub
scanners.why: BGC039 is exactly this; decorates bioactives
scanners.test_note: BGC039+BGC001 — BGC039 is the confirmed deoxysugar hub

scanners.name: Aminosugar / nitrogen-sugar
scanners.why: aminosugars common on macrolides/anthracyclines
scanners.test_note: 14 hits — aminotransferase is common; tighten to DegT/WecE-specific HMM, not generic Aminotran

scanners.name: Siderophore completeness (NIS vs NRPS)
scanners.why: conserved in your strains; hive/host fitness
scanners.test_note: 3 clusters — siderophore synthases

scanners.name: Butyrolactone / gamma-butyrolactone quorum signal
scanners.why: controls secondary-metabolism onset; you have 2, both conserved
scanners.test_note: BGC026+BGC037 — butyrolactone AfsA

scanners.name: Melanin / protective pigment
scanners.why: UV/oxidative protection in the host niche
scanners.test_note: BGC003+BGC060 — melanin

scanners.name: Beta-lactone / reactive electrophile
scanners.why: covalent proteasome/enzyme inhibitors
scanners.test_note: no domain-name proxy available; needs HMM to test

scanners.name: Phosphonate
scanners.why: cell-wall / Glu-synthesis inhibitors
scanners.test_note: 3 hits on 'phosph' keyword — real HMM (PepM) will be far more specific; keyword proxy is loose

scanners.name: Polyether / large modular PKS (ionophore/macrolide)
scanners.why: trained on 6 MIBiG polyether/polyene positives; fires on ionostatin in AS-XXX
scanners.test_note: fires on c1.1.r014 (ionostatin, 128kb KS=8) + 3 other large-PKS; validated on 6 training BGCs

scanners.name: trans-AT PKS (macrolactone)
scanners.why: trans-AT systems have fewer discrete KS genes; gate on tra_KS motif NOT KS count
scanners.test_note: fires on c2.1.r006 (marinolide body, transAT) which PK01's KS>=5 count MISSED — this is the calibration fix

scanners.name: Diketopiperazine (CDPS / albonoursin-like)
scanners.why: CDPS is the discriminating tRNA-dependent DKP synthase
scanners.test_note: fires on c1.1.r001 (photopiperazine, CDPS) — clean single-domain gate

scanners.name: Halogenated pyrrole (pyrrolnitrin/chlorizidine-type)
scanners.why: pyrrole + poly-halogenation is a defined bioactive scaffold
scanners.test_note: fires on c4.1.r003 (tetrachlorizine, polyhalogenated-pyrrole) — the confirmed known

scanners.name: Meroterpenoid (terpene-polyketide hybrid)
scanners.why: mero = terpene fused to polyketide/aromatic; needs the prenyltransferase bridge
scanners.test_note: terpene regions found (c1.1.r010 etc) but prenyltransferase gate not yet HMM-confirmed; needs the aromatic-PT model

scanners.name: Nucleoside antibiotic
scanners.why: trained on polyoxin+tunicamycin; anti-chitin/cell-wall antifungals
scanners.test_note: validated on polyoxin+tunicamycin training BGCs; AS-XXX has no nucleoside cluster (correct absence)

scanners.name: Lipopeptide (acylated NRPS)
scanners.rule: NRPS C-A-PCP modules + N-terminal fatty-acyl loading (starter C or FAAL)
scanners.trap: plain NRPS with no acyl starter; siderophore NRPS (use EC01)
scanners.why: acyl chain + cyclic peptide = membrane-active; anti-MRSA (daptomycin) & antifungal (iturin)
scanners.test_note: to be tested on attine strains

scanners.name: Glycolipopeptide / acidic lipopeptide (Ca2+-dependent)
scanners.rule: acyl-NRPS with acidic residues (Ca-binding) + optional sugar
scanners.why: calcium-dependent antibiotics (CDA family); the daptomycin class, anti-Gram-positive
scanners.test_note: A54145 was a MIBiG anchor in AS-XXX KCB — trainable

scanners.name: Ansamycin (AHBA/mC7N starter macrolactam)
scanners.rule: AHBA synthase present (the mC7N starter unit) — detects ansamycins even when the modular PKS is fragmented
scanners.trap: generic DHQ_synthase (shikimate primary metabolism); aminoshikimate w/o AHBA
scanners.why: AHBA synthase is the class signature of ALL ansamycins; a discrete gene, so it survives assembly fragmentation that hides the modular PKS
scanners.test_note: mycotrienin ground truth: AHBA_synth_RP on SID10815 c01012 — the scanner that would have caught the miss | STATUS: gate HMM AHBA_synth not yet in bundle/addon Pfam sets (35-core or 148) — scanner specified + ground-truth-confirmed (AHBA_synth_RP on SID10815 c01012) but engine cannot fire AN01 until the AHBA_synth HMM is sourced.
